verdicts.reason: A: the 'Obsidian Buds, $179' subline is tiny and unreadable at this size, and it is left-shifted so it doesn't line up with the headline above it. The Shop button is oversized and crowds the right edge. B: the headline and subline form a clean, readable centred stack and the order (brand, headline, product, Shop) works, but the logo sits high instead of being vertically centred and the product is small and floating in its gap, so it needs polish before shipping.
